title: The Rank of Apparition: k ∣ Fₙ ↔ (entry point of k) ∣ n
description: Proves the exact Fibonacci divisibility characterization k ∣ Fₙ ↔ α(k) ∣ n, where α(k) is the rank of apparition (Fibonacci entry point) of k. The characterization from minimality needs no finiteness (via Nat.fib_gcd and Nat.fib_dvd); existence of α(k) for every k ≥ 1 is the substantive input, proved by a pigeonhole/periodicity argument on the pair sequence (Fₙ, Fₙ₊₁) ∈ (ZMod k)², making entryPoint k a genuine computable definition. decide only, no native_decide. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
